sentences.en: (Applause) Robbie Mizzone: Thank you. Tommy Mizzone: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 罗比·米佐:谢谢。汤米·米佐:非常感谢。

sentences.en: We're so excited to be here. It's such an honor.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴能来这里 真是太荣幸了

sentences.en: Like he said, we're three brothers from New Jersey -- you know, the bluegrass capital of the world.
sentences.zh: 就像他说的,我们是三个兄弟 来自新泽西-- 你知道,世界的蓝草城。

sentences.en: (Laughter) We discovered bluegrass a few years ago, and we fell in love with it.
sentences.zh: 几年前我们发现了蓝草 我们爱上了蓝草

sentences.en: We hope you guys will too. This next song is an original we wrote called "Time Lapse," and it will probably live up to its name.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你们也能这样。下首歌是我们写的原创, 叫做“Time Lapse”, 它可能会名副其实。

sentences.en: (Tuning) (Music)
sentences.zh: (吐声) (音乐)

sentences.en: (Music ends) (Applause) TM: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 非常感谢。

sentences.en: RM: I'm just going to take a second to introduce the band.
sentences.zh: RM:我只需要一秒钟 介绍乐队。

sentences.en: On guitar is my 15-year-old brother Tommy.
sentences.zh: 吉他是我15岁的哥哥汤米

sentences.en: (Applause) On banjo is 10-year-old Jonny.
sentences.zh: (掌声)班卓是10岁的琼尼。

sentences.en: (Applause) He's also our brother. And I'm Robbie, and I'm 14, and I play the fiddle.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 他也是我们的兄弟 我是罗比,我14岁,我玩小提琴

sentences.en: (Applause) As you can see, we decided to make it hard on ourselves, and we chose to play three songs in three different keys.
sentences.zh: (掌声) 正如你可以看到的, 我们决定让自己很难过, 我们选择玩三首歌 在三个不同的键。

sentences.en: (Tuning) Yeah. I'm also going to explain, a lot of people want to know where we got the name "Sleepy Man Banjo Boys" from.
sentences.zh: 是啊,我还要解释 很多人想知道我们从哪弄来的"睡梦男人班乔男孩"

sentences.en: So, it started when Jonny was little, and he first started the banjo, he would play on his back with his eyes closed, and we'd say it looked like he was sleeping.
sentences.zh: 所以,它开始的时候,琼尼是小, 他第一次开始班卓琴, 他会玩他的背 闭着眼睛,

sentences.en: So you can probably piece the rest together.
sentences.zh: 所以,你可能可以把其余的拼在一起。

sentences.en: TM: We can't really figure out the reason.
sentences.zh: TM:我们真的搞不清楚原因。

sentences.en: It might have been that it weighs about a million pounds.
sentences.zh: 可能是它重约一百万磅
